desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located inside the temple. You will have to dive into the water will be helpful. After diving in and passing the gold chest there will be a hole to swim further down. The relief is found in this room.

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located inside the temple, enter underwater from the east end. Upon entering avoid the arrow traps after surfacing and the dead-mans chest. You will have to dive into the water on the right side of the locked door, will be helpful. After diving in pass the door switch and circle around. The relief will be located in a small room with .

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients.

The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located inside the temple. First you will have to gain entry by enabling the two switches in the side buildings next to the pool. Once opened Drak will flood out, defeat them and enter the temple under water, will be helpful. Swim through on the left and avoid the spike traps. On the other side swim over some rubble into another room where the relief will be located.

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.
obtain: This collectible is found at Cromville Throneroom. It is located inside a bathroom on the north west end.

desc: A showcase that holds pieces of a Drak themed relief. Collect all pieces to complete this showcase and unlock special trophy recipes.

obtain: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving any of the 7 of the Drak Relief piece.

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon — a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located inside the temple. Descend down until the path splits at the lava and take the right. Following it around you will come to a grapple anchor, glide down south to the platform, then turn around and glide to the other side. Follow through the doorway and you'll see floor spikes on the other end of the hall is the relief.

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located inside the temple. First you must open the inside door, the switch is in a crawlspace behind a pile of crates. Then you'll be directed through the underwater maze using a number of blue light switches that illuminate green lamps lighting the way. After doing a few switches you'll swim up to a large open room with open air and grating above, the room will have . On the west wall of this room in the water holds this relief.

desc:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.
obtain: This collectible is found at Drak'Dal Temple. It is located behind one of the grates blocking in the Snapjaw. The gate opens after hitting the switch to release the water.
